scope: Curated Oracle operational domains and product families; not an exhaustive product or SKU inventory
count_semantics: Entries are routing units and may group products. CLI command/family counts are separate metrics.

validation_levels.docs_reviewed: Central public documentation reviewed; no deployment or integration test implied
validation_levels.discovery_only: Research/navigation pointer; detailed capabilities, regions, pricing and limits not revalidated

products.decision: Separate cluster/node lifecycle from application rollout

products.name: Container Instances
products.decision: Container runtime without a managed Kubernetes application model

products.name: Functions

products.name: VCN, routing, load balancing and connectivity

products.name: Object, Block and File Storage
products.decision: Object versus block versus file semantics; backup and restore ownership

products.name: IAM and Identity Domains

products.name: Vault, Cloud Guard, Security Zones, Data Safe and Bastion
products.decision: Metadata access versus secret material; assessment versus enforcement

products.name: Monitoring, Logging, Audit, APM and related services
products.decision: Metric/log/trace/resource-search queries have different scope and syntax

products.name: OCI DevOps
products.decision: Build and deployment identity, immutable artifacts and rollout verification

products.name: Artifact Registry and Container Registry (OCIR)
products.decision: Generic artifacts and container images have different clients and identities

products.name: Terraform OCI provider
products.decision: Desired state, ownership, import coverage and reviewed plan

products.name: Resource Manager
products.decision: Managed engine versions, state, plan/apply jobs and drift

products.name: OCI Ansible collection
products.decision: Pin collection and verify idempotency/check mode for each module

products.name: OCI language SDKs
products.decision: Runtime signer, pagination, bounded retries and typed errors

products.name: Autonomous AI Database

products.name: Base Database and Exadata database deployments
products.decision: Deployment model, engine version, licensing and backup responsibilities

products.name: MySQL HeatWave

products.name: OCI NoSQL and PostgreSQL
products.decision: Engine semantics, regional service support, extensions and data lifecycle

products.name: Oracle APEX
products.decision: Application/workspace migration differs from database provisioning

products.name: Oracle REST Data Services
products.decision: Database grants, HTTP identity and exposed SQL/report tools

products.name: SQLcl, OCI Database Tools and ORDS MCP
products.decision: Choose hosting/identity model and inspect tools and database privileges

products.name: OCI Generative AI and Generative AI Agents
products.decision: Model availability, endpoint region and execution cost are separate concerns

products.name: Data Science, Vision, Language, Speech and Document Understanding
products.decision: Training/hosting versus specialized inference and data handling

products.name: Streaming, Queue, Data Flow, Data Integration, Data Catalog and GoldenGate

products.name: Integration, Analytics, Visual Builder and Digital Assistant

products.name: Oracle Linux, Java Management, GraalVM and WebLogic
